topic: Analytics dashboard performance issues and fixes
summary_markdown:
The conversation focused on performance degradation within the analytics platform. Initially, there were technical errors related to cache dictionary updates when querying traffic totals.

Later discussion confirmed that a recent merge/rollback of `ml-api` caused slowness in processing for test campaigns (specifically mentioning 'Семена'). While an earlier version was faster, it sometimes experienced crashes. The current issue is general slowdown and instability across both the new and old versions of the tool.
decisions: The previous merge/rollback of ml-api caused performance issues.
action_items: Investigate dashboard slowness and instability on staging environment (https://staging-analytics.allunite.[redacted]).
Review the stability issue documented in AllUnite Issue #1497 regarding both new and old versions of the tool.
